matrix_note: Pinned v0.6.10 source 3915ce9814b8261a1ab13ed93adec58b463cd75c: router/relay.go exposes OpenAI chat ingress, not native Responses, Anthropic, Gemini, Cohere or Bedrock ingress. relay/adaptor supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cohere (v1/chat) and AWS Bedrock (relay/adaptor/aws, InvokeModel through the AWS SDK at its default HTTPS endpoint, which the engine v1.2 catch-all DNS resolves to the mock) upstreams.
